title.rendered: End of the Year Event Details

content.rendered:
Click here to get all the details for the end of the year, including upcoming events, reminders and staff announcements for next year!

Last Day of School Events:

  • June 8th: Last day for 8th grade and 8th Grade Promotion
  • June 9th: KG-7th Last Day (1/2 day)
    • 1st– 4th Grade Stepping Stones Ceremony
    • KG Graduation & 5th Grade Promotion
    • 6th and 7th Grade Activity Day

View all the details here!
